description: Venture 9.2.1: monthly leagues become the primary competition screen; the legacy overall XP ranking and ranking-image export are removed from the UI without deleting user records, lifetime XP, duel history, or level progression. Includes lighter initial script loading, a minimal non-retained heartbeat payload, and less frequent update-install checks. Monthly league season launch remains planned for November 2026. Internal notifications and All Star features from 9.2.0 remain. Web Push with the site closed still requires backend/VAPID setup.
